run_setup_py: run the faiss setup.py to assemble the python package and copy compiled shared libraries
review_setup_py: review the faiss setup.py to understand how it assembles the package directory and copies swigfaiss libraries
refactor_setup_py: refactor the faiss setup.py to add support for a new CPU instruction set variant library
summarize_setup_py: summarize the faiss setup.py which copies python wrappers and compiled .so/.pyd libraries into the faiss package
test_setup_py: test the faiss setup.py by running it to verify all expected shared libraries are found and copied
